title: Rise Path lesson review (review.v1)
description: What a reviewer (pedagogy-reviewer, ja-editor, visual-qa, a CI judge or a human) returns for one lesson, scored against content/schema/rubric.v1.json. Hand-written; usable with `claude -p --json-schema`. Check one or more reviews with `node .claude/skills/review-lesson/scripts/check-review.mjs <file>…`.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the reviewed file, e.g. content/courses/vibe-coding/drafts/vibe-ch1-practice.lesson.json.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed: pedagogy-reviewer, ja-editor, visual-qa, ci or human:<name>.

scores.description: One entry per criterion in the reviewer's scope. pedagogy-reviewer scores all 13; ja-editor and visual-qa score the criteria they can judge.

evidence.description: One or two sentences that quote the lesson or name block ids.

mustFix.description: Changes required before the lesson can pass. Each fix is specific enough to apply without guessing.

blockId.description: Block, section or objective id; "lesson" for lesson-wide issues.

screenshot.description: visual-qa only: the PNG that shows the issue, relative to the preview folder.

average.description: Mean of the scores given. Optional; check-review.mjs recomputes it.

verdict.description: pass: every scored criterion ≥ 3, mean ≥ 3.3, no mustFix. revise: fixable. reject: wrong audience or outcome; needs a rewrite.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the author: the biggest strength and the most important fix.
